sampling.external_bot_holdout: deterministic 1/10 game-level sample selected by first 32 bits of semantic SHA-256 identity

descriptive_findings: The external-bot calibration shift is not uniform across strata.
Offer 20 shows the largest eligible shared-stratum calibration-gap shift in this report: external minus test approximately -0.318.
ANSWERER decisions show a larger negative external calibration-gap shift than the overall population, approximately -0.187.
Actor 1 as ANSWERER is a particularly shifted stratum in the deterministic sample, approximately -0.197 external-minus-test calibration-gap change.
The 18-24 bid band carries most of the observed external shift among the broad bid bands.
These are diagnostic distribution-shift observations, not evidence that changing thresholds or retraining on the external-bot holdout would improve gameplay.
